rationale: The change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly states that the vulnerable-road-user vs other-object distinction must be reassessed. In the baseline, H1-ORR2 depends on FR-7.2.2 via H1-A2, with H1-RC2 defined to revalidate if FR-7.2.2 or the object-category scheme changes. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged, so the appropriate lifecycle action is to revalidate only H1-ORR2.
